productBoot.failure: Steam interfaces not ready in product mode
productBoot.finding: Confirmed runtime: a standalone process from the lab game copy, with no lab environment and a temporary d2coop/d2coop.cfg, activated product mode by itself (status in d2coop, partner assets detected, controller waiting_partner) and was cleaned up afterwards. Failed only on Steam readiness: Steam interfaces were acquired lazily on host/join, so the GameLobbyJoinRequested callback was not registered at boot (an in-game Steam Join/accepted invite would be missed), and the lab loopback listener still opened in product mode. Fixed in the next candidate.
